<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#f5f7fc;
    --bg-alt:#eef1fa;
    --surface:#ffffff;
    --ink:#10152b;
    --ink-soft:#5c6478;
    --line:#e1e5f2;
    --indigo:#4f46e5;
    --indigo-dark:#3c34b5;
    --indigo-bg:#edeafe;
    --blue:#2563eb;
    --blue-bg:#e7f0fe;
    --cyan:#0891b2;
    --cyan-bg:#e1f6fb;
    --violet:#7c3aed;
    --violet-bg:#f2ecfe;
    --pink:#db2777;
    --pink-bg:#fde7f2;
    --mint:#0d9488;
    --mint-bg:#dff5f1;
    --amber:#d97706;
    --amber-bg:#fdf0dc;
    --gray:#6b7280;
    --gray-bg:#eef0f4;
    --radius:16px;
    --maxw:1160px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:"Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);
    background:var(--surface);
    line-height:1.55;
  }
  img,svg{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}
  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 .5em;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.02em;}
  h1{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5.4vw,4.2rem);font-weight:800;}
  h2{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.2vw,3.1rem);}
  h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:.5em;}
  h4{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:.3em;}
  p{margin:0 0 1em;}
  section{padding:88px 0;}
  .section-white{background:var(--surface);}
  .section-tint{background:var(--bg-alt);}
  .section-dark{background:var(--ink);color:#e7e9f5;}
  .section-dark h2,.section-dark h3,.section-dark h4{color:#fff;}
  .section-gradient{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#3730a3 0%,#4f46e5 45%,#0891b2 100%);color:#fff;}
  .section-gradient h2{color:#fff;}
  .section-pricing{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eef0fe 0%,#e5f6fb 100%);}
  .lede{font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:640px;margin-bottom:1.5em;}
  .section-dark .lede{color:#b6bcd8;}
  .section-gradient .lede{color:#e4e8ff;}
  .center{text-align:center;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .cite{font-size:.62em;vertical-align:super;line-height:0;color:var(--indigo);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;margin-left:1px;}
  .eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.6vw,1.05rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:20px;}
  .section-dark .eyebrow{color:#a5b4fc;}
  .section-gradient .eyebrow{color:#c7d2fe;}
  .head-center{text-align:center;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 48px;}
  .head-center .lede{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .subhead{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.25rem,2.4vw,1.6rem);color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 18px;}
  .section-gradient .subhead{color:#e4e8ff;}
  .color-strip{height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--indigo),var(--blue),var(--cyan),var(--violet),var(--pink));}
  /* Buttons */
  .btn{
    display:inline-block;padding:16px 32px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;
    text-decoration:none;font-size:1rem;border:1.5px solid transparent;
    transition:transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;
  }
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(79,70,229,.28);}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--indigo-dark);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(79,70,229,.34);}
  .btn-outline{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--ink);}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--indigo);color:var(--indigo);}
  .cta-note{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;}
  .section-dark .cta-note{color:#8991b8;}
  .section-gradient .btn-primary,.final-cta .btn-primary{background:#fff;color:var(--indigo);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(16,21,43,.22);}
  .section-gradient .btn-primary:hover,.final-cta .btn-primary:hover{background:#f2f4ff;}
  /* Header */
  header.site{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(245,247,252,.88);backdrop-filter:saturate(160%) blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  header.site .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:14px;}
  .brand{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;}
  .brand span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  header.site .btn{padding:10px 22px;font-size:.86rem;}
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);justify-self:center;}
  .nav-links a{text-decoration:none;}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--indigo);}
  /* Hero */
  .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:64px 0 60px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eef1fc 0%,var(--surface) 75%);}
  .hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:52px;align-items:center;}
  .hero-visual-slot{min-height:360px;}
  .blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.16;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;}
  .blob-1{width:520px;height:520px;background:var(--blue);top:-240px;right:-180px;}
  .hero-actions{margin-top:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center;}
  .trust-line{margin-top:22px;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;}
  .trust-line span{margin:0 4px;color:var(--line);}
  /* Hero report stack */
  .report-stack{position:relative;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;height:440px;}
  .stack-card{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(16,21,43,.16);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px 20px;}
  .stack-card .rp-tag{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .stack-card .rp-page-title{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--ink);}
  .card-back-left{top:64px;left:6px;width:260px;min-height:170px;transform:rotate(-2deg);z-index:1;opacity:.9;}
  .card-back-right{top:40px;right:6px;width:260px;min-height:170px;transform:rotate(2deg);z-index:2;opacity:.95;}
  .card-front{top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(0deg);z-index:3;width:260px;min-height:190px;}
  .rp-score-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:.74rem;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-alt);}
  .rp-score-row .pill{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:800;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;}
  .rp-mini-bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;height:64px;margin-top:4px;}
  .rp-mini-bars .mbar{flex:1;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;}
  .rp-mini-timeline{position:relative;height:50px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 4px;}
  .rp-mini-timeline::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:4px;right:4px;top:50%;height:2px;background:var(--line);}
  .mt-dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .float-badge{
    position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 16px;
    font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(16,21,43,.16);
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;z-index:4;border:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .float-badge .fdot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .badge-1{top:-16px;left:-36px;transform:rotate(-3deg);}
  .badge-2{bottom:36px;right:-40px;transform:rotate(3deg);}
  .badge-3{bottom:-16px;left:20px;transform:rotate(-2deg);}
  /* How it works */
  .steps-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:40px;margin-top:16px;position:relative;}
  .step-col{text-align:center;position:relative;}
  .step-visual{width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:26px;margin:0 auto 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;}
  .step-col h3{font-size:1.15rem;}
  .step-col p{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:260px;margin:0 auto;}
  .step-arrow{position:absolute;top:50px;right:-32px;width:64px;color:var(--line);z-index:1;}
  /* mini illustrations */
  .mini-browser{width:82px;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(16,21,43,.1);overflow:hidden;}
  .mini-browser .bar{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:6px 7px;background:var(--bg-alt);}
  .mini-browser .bar span{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line);}
  .mini-browser .body{padding:8px 8px 10px;}
  .mini-browser .field{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--bg-alt);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .mini-browser .submit{height:12px;width:60%;border-radius:6px;background:var(--indigo);margin-top:4px;}
  .mini-scan{position:relative;width:78px;height:78px;}
  .mini-scan .ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid;}
  .mini-scan .r1{width:78px;height:78px;left:0;top:0;border-color:var(--blue-bg);}
  .mini-scan .r2{width:56px;height:56px;left:11px;top:11px;border-color:var(--cyan-bg);}
  .mini-scan .r3{width:34px;height:34px;left:22px;top:22px;border-color:var(--violet-bg);}
  .mini-scan svg{position:absolute;top:24px;left:24px;width:30px;height:30px;}
  .mini-report{width:78px;}
  .mini-report .page{background:#fff;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(16,21,43,.1);padding:8px;margin-bottom:0;}
  .mini-report .row{height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--bg-alt);margin-bottom:5px;}
  .mini-report .check{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mint);position:relative;margin:-14px auto 0;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(13,148,136,.4);}
  /* Search is changing / orbit6 */
  .orbit6-wrap{max-width:520px;margin:44px auto 0;}
  .orbit6{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;}
  .orbit6-svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;}
  .orbit6-center{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:30%;height:30%;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--indigo);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(255,255,255,.2),0 20px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.3);z-index:2;}
  .orbit6-center svg{width:26px;height:26px;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .orbit6-node{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;z-index:1;}
  .orbit6-node .circle{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(16,21,43,.22);}
  .orbit6-node .circle svg{width:24px;height:24px;}
  .orbit6-node span{font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;}
  /* SEO still works — big stats */
  .stat-trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px;margin-top:16px;}
  .stat-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:36px 20px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(16,21,43,.05);}
  .stat-card .big{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5vw,3.2rem);line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .stat-card p{font-size:.98rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;}
  .stat-foot{margin-top:32px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-soft);text-align:center;max-width:640px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .sources-block{margin-top:22px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--gray);text-align:center;}
  .sources-block a{color:var(--gray);text-decoration:underline;}
  /* What's inside */
  .report-row{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:stretch;gap:20px;margin:12px 0 64px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .report-row .report-page{
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:5px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;
    padding:20px;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(16,21,43,.08);width:230px;height:220px;position:relative;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  }
  .rp-tag{font-size:.62rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .rp-page-title{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:14px;color:var(--ink);}
  .module-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:26px;}
  .module-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:32px 34px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(16,21,43,.05);}
  .module-icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .module-icon svg{width:26px;height:26px;}
  .module-card .cluster-num{display:inline-block;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;}
  .module-card h3{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .module-card ul{margin:0;list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
  .module-card li{background:var(--bg-alt);color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;}
  /* Methodology */
  .method-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:16px;}
  .method-card{border-radius:14px;padding:22px 18px;}
  .method-card .tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .method-card p{font-size:.86rem;color:#c3cae2;margin:0;}
  /* Timeline */
  .timeline{display:flex;position:relative;margin-top:52px;padding-top:6px;gap:12px;}
  .timeline-road{position:absolute;top:0px;left:0;width:100%;height:60px;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;}
  .timeline-step{flex:1;text-align:center;position:relative;padding:0 6px;}
  .timeline-dot{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:.9rem;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;margin:0 auto 18px;position:relative;z-index:1;border:5px solid var(--surface);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(16,21,43,.14);}
  .timeline-step h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1rem;}
  .timeline-step p{font-size:.84rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;}
  .timeline-note{margin-top:14px;}
  /* Who this is for */
  .fit-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:56px;align-items:start;}
  .fit-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;}
  .fit-usecase{border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px 24px;border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .fit-usecase .fu-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .fit-usecase .fu-icon svg{width:20px;height:20px;}
  .fit-usecase p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;}
  /* Value / pricing */
  .value-box{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:40px 44px 0;margin:16px auto 0;max-width:640px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(16,21,43,.1);text-align:center;}
  .value-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;}
  .value-list li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-alt);font-size:.98rem;}
  .value-list li .vi-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
  .value-list li .vi-check{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--mint-bg);color:var(--mint);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .value-list li .vi-price{color:var(--gray);font-weight:600;font-size:.84rem;white-space:nowrap;}
  .value-list li .vi-sub{display:block;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px;}
  .value-total{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:18px 0;border-top:2px solid var(--line);margin-top:2px;font-size:.94rem;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .value-total b{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;text-decoration:line-through;font-weight:700;}
  .value-price{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo-bg),var(--cyan-bg));margin:0 -44px;padding:28px 30px 32px;}
  .value-price span{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.86rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .value-price b{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,7vw,4.4rem);color:var(--indigo);line-height:1;}
  .value-price .sub{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;margin-top:8px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;}
  .value-box .btn{margin:24px 0 8px;}
  .value-box .cta-note{padding-bottom:28px;}
  .scope-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:32px;margin-top:48px;max-width:640px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .scope-grid h3{text-align:center;}
  .scope-list{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;}
